problems_and_friction: No blockers. Had to discover the tool unaided: used `clan --help` then `clan agent-help` for the agent protocol, and unzipped the .clan to confirm the schema was open (type: object only) and data.yaml was empty before writing. Chose pack-html with `structured:` + `decision:` YAML frontmatter because hop 1 is the initial render that must seed BOTH the data shape and a rich full-html view in one legitimate write (data-only patch-data would not render the view). The decision chain auto-recorded fields_changed and a timestamp; no manual decision step needed. File validates OK after the write.
context_understood: Hop 1 of 3 in a market-entry analysis for Brightline Logistics expanding to Germany. I am the market-analyst: I sized the German logistics market (€320bn, 4.2% CAGR to €377bn by 2028, #1 in Europe), listed demand drivers, broke down 5 segments by share + entry attractiveness, captured entry barriers and opportunities, and set a preliminary attractiveness score of 7.5/10. Data merge-patches forward, so later hops only restate keys they change. Left an explicit handoff for hop 2 (competitive & financial analyst: profile top-5 incumbents, estimate capex/break-even, pressure-test the 7.5 score) and noted hop 3 is the synthesis lead who delivers the go/no-go recommendation. analysts.market_analyst flag set to 'complete'.
